g.text: 1. ALL WORK SHALL COMPLY WITH BS EN 1997-1 (EUROCODE 7) AND BS 8004.
2. Concrete grade: C25/30 (fck=25 MPa) minimum — all structural elements.
3. Reinforcement: Grade B500B — Min. lap length = 40 × bar diameter.
4. Minimum cover to reinforcement: 50mm to all exposed faces; 40mm internal.
5. Foundation depth minimum 1200mm below finished ground level (frost protection).
6. All dimensions are in millimetres unless otherwise noted.
7. Contractor to verify subsoil conditions before pouring concrete — Report to SE.
